items.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Have you seen it (addressing Ken Kimery).

ctx.x: Have you seen it (addressing Ken Kimery). You think the Germans are off the hook, the Japanese are really off the hook. (Laughs). They detail some stuff.

They promote like it's going out of style. That is why I went over there. That is what the whole trip was about. It was about promotion. We did seven concerts. But, actually, the concerts were incidental because they were promoting the two previous CDs.
